cold: F04A.1 previous PCM/raw regular/prefix/current/component audio states are +0; diffusion map empty. This reference only owns prefix arithmetic inputs and outputs.
callback: Previous/current prefix arrays clear to +0 independently each callback. Tail and output traversal increasing; contributions add to old_output in that order. Gain/branch/mode for the current callback apply to both halves.
filter_cold_activation: F04A.4/F04F: newly active object filter processes previous PCM || current PCM; split previous/current filter outputs. Continuously active processes only current PCM and reuses saved prior filter outputs for previous half.
inactive_then_reactivate: Remove inactive filter instance and previous outputs; reactivation constructs cold state, never resurrects old filter state.
membership: Only nonquiet, width>0, finite gain>0 and gain>=R32(1e-6) writes; equality included. Complete11 gain vector provider required; absent call does not imply zero gain. Low-level arithmetic test cases do not expand caller membership domain.
commit: Raw PCM and active filter state/outputs commit at callback end under approved owner transaction. Prefix previous half is recomputed with current gain, never stale prior prefix or current-total subtraction.
failure: Precheck shape/finite/control; fatal fail-stop according to approved transaction contract. No native rollback equivalence asserted.
reset_and_eof: Full owner reconstruction follows the applicable existing parent contract. This primitive adds no EOF schedule. Main F02 cached drain and independent-meter F06 fresh zero-input drain remain distinct.
